SAMPID: Sample ID, GTEx Public Sample ID
SMNABTCHT: Type of nucleic acid isolation batch
SMNABTCHD: Date of nucleic acid isolation batch
SMGEBTCHD: Date of genotype or expression batch
SMGEBTCHT: Type of genotype or expression batch
SMMTRLTP: Current material type of the sample as stored at the LDACC
SMNOTES: Internal notes about the sample generated by the LDACC
SMOMTRLTP: Original material type of the collected sample
SMPTHNTS: Pathology Notes, notes from PRC Report
SMSTYP: Indicates whether sample is a tumor or a normal
SMTS: Tissue Type, area from which the tissue sample was taken. This is a parent value to SMTSD.
SMTSD: Tissue Type, more specific detail of tissue type
SMUBRID: Uberon ID, anatomical location as described by the Uber Anatomy Ontology (UBERON)
SMUBRTRM: Uberon Term, anatomical location as described by the Uber Anatomy Ontology (UBERON)
SMTSISCH: Total Ischemic time for a sample
SMTSPAX: Time a sample spent in the PAXgene fixative
SMTORMVE: Samples flagged for removal from analysis
SMAFRZE: Samples included in the GTEx Analysis Freeze
SMGTC: Name of the genotype gtc file
SMALTALG: Alternative Alignments: Reads that were mapped as secondary alignments (0x100 flag)
SMSUPALG: Supplementary Alignments: Reads that were mapped as supplementary alignments (0x800 flag)
SMVQCFL: Failed Vendor QC: Reads (unique) that failed platform/vendor QC (0x200 flag)
SMLMAPQ: Low Mapping Quality: Non-Failed Vendor QC reads that did not pass the mapping quality (MAPQ) threshold (--mapping-quality option)
SMUMPRD: Unique Mapping, Vendor QC Passed Reads: Reads that were neither Alternative Alignments nor Failed Vendor QC
SMUNPDRD: Unpaired Reads: Unique Mapping, Vendor QC Passed Reads that were unpaired
SMMPPD: Mapped Reads: Unique Mapping, Vendor QC Passed Reads that were mapped
SMMAPRT: Mapping Rate: Proportion of Mapped Reads to Total Reads
SMMPPDUN: Mapped Unique Reads: Mapped Reads that were not duplicates
SMUNMPRT: Unique Rate of Mapped: Proportion of Mapped Unique Reads to Mapped Reads
SMMPDP: Mapped Duplicate Reads: Mapped Reads that were marked as PCR or optical duplicates (0x400 flag)
SMDPMPRT: Duplicate Rate of Mapped: Proportion of Mapped Duplicate Reads to Mapped Reads. Complementary to Unique Rate of Mapped
SMMPPDXG: Non-Globin Reads: Mapped Reads excluding reads mapping to HBA1, HBA2, HBB, HBD, etc. genes
SMMPDPXG: Non-Globin Duplicate Reads: Duplicate Reads excluding reads mapping to HBA1, HBA2, HBB, HBD, etc. genes
SMDPRTXG: Duplicate Rate of Mapped, excluding Globins: Proportion of Non-Globin Duplicate Reads to Non-Globin Reads
SMCHMRD: Chimeric Fragments: Chimeric alignments among Mapped Reads, based on the tag specified with --chimeric-tag (default: 'ch'). If no chimeric reads are identified based on tag, Mapped Reads mapping to multiple contigs, or >2Mb apart on the same contig, will be counted as chimeric
SMCHMRT: Chimeric Alignment Rate: Proportion of Chimeric Reads to Mapped Reads
SMMPPDPR: Total Mapped Pairs: Mapped Reads pairs that were mapped as proper pairs
SMMPHQRD: High Quality Reads: Mapped Reads that passed the following criteria: aligned as proper pairs, mismatches ('NM' tag) at or below threshold (--base-mismatch option), passed mapping quality (MAPQ) threshold (--mapping-quality option)
SMMPHQRT: High Quality Rate: Proportion of High Quality Reads among Mapped Reads
SMMPLQRD: Low Quality Reads: Mapped Reads that were not High Quality Reads
SMSPLTRT: Avg. Splits per Read: Average number of gaps or deletions (N or D in the CIGAR string, respectively) in Mapped Reads
SME1MPRD: End 1 Mapped Reads: Paired reads which were marked as first (0x40 flag) in the pair out of Mapped Reads
SME2MPRD: End 2 Mapped Reads: Paired reads which were marked as second (0x80 flag) in the pair out of Mapped Reads
SME1MPRT: End 1 Mapping Rate: Proportion of End 1 Mapped Reads to Unique Mapping, Vendor QC Passed Reads
SME2MPRT: End 2 Mapping Rate: Proportion of End 2 Mapped Reads to Unique Mapping, Vendor QC Passed Reads
SME1MMB: End 1 Mismatches: Total mismatched bases ('NM' tag) of End 1 Mapped Reads
SME2MMB: End 2 Mismatches: Total mismatched bases ('NM' tag) of End 2 Mapped Reads
SME1TTLB: End 1 Bases: Total aligned length of End 1 Mapped Reads
SME2TTLB: End 2 Bases: Total aligned length of End 2 Mapped Reads
SME1MMRT: End 1 Mismatch Rate: End 1 Mismatches divided by End 1 Bases
SME2MMRT: End 2 Mismatch Rate: End 2 Mismatches divided by End 2 Bases
SMTTLMM: Mismatched Bases: Total mismatched bases (from 'NM' tag) in Mapped Reads
SMTTLB: Total Bases: Total aligned bases in Mapped Reads
SMBSMMRT: Base Mismatch Rate: Mismatched Bases divided by Total Bases
SMESTLBS: Estimated Library Complexity: Estimated number of unique cDNA fragments in the library, based on Mapped Reads. The computation is identical to Picard's EstimateLibraryComplexity
SMEXNCRD: Exonic Reads: Mapped Reads for which all aligned segments unambiguously aligned to exons of the same gene
SMEXNCRT: Exonic Rate: Proportion of Exonic Reads among Mapped Reads
SMEXPEFF: Expression Profiling Efficiency: Proportion of Exonic Reads among Unique Mapping, Vendor QC Passed Reads
SMNTRNRD: Intronic Reads: Mapped Reads for which all aligned segments unambiguously aligned to the same gene, without intersecting any of its exons
SMNTRNRT: Intronic Rate: Proportion of Intronic Reads among Mapped Reads
SMNTRARD: Intragenic Reads: Sum of Exonic Reads and Intronic Reads
SMNTRART: Intragenic Rate: Proportion of Intragenic Reads among Mapped Reads
SMNTERRD: Intergenic Reads: Mapped Reads for which none of the aligned segments intersected any genes
SMNTERRT: Intergenic Rate: Proportion of Intergenic Reads among Mapped Reads
SMAMBRD: Ambiguous Reads: Mapped Reads for which the aligned segments aligned to multiple genes or a combination of exons and introns
SMAMBRT: Ambiguous Alignment Rate: Proportion of Ambiguous Reads among Mapped Reads
SMNTEXC: Reads used for Intron/Exon counts: Mapped Reads that were further filtered with optional command line flags (such as --exclude-chimeric or --tag). Equivalent to Mapped Reads if no filters are provided (default)
SMDSCRT: Discard Rate: Proportion of Mapped Reads that were filtered with optional command line flags (such as --exclude-chimeric or --tag)
SMEXNCRTHQ: High Quality Exonic Rate: Proportion of Exonic Reads among High Quality Reads
SMNTRNRTHQ: High Quality Intronic Rate: Proportion of Intronic Reads among High Quality Reads
SMNTRARTHQ: High Quality Intragenic Rate: Proportion of Intragenic Reads among High Quality Reads
SMNTERRTHQ: High Quality Intergenic Rate: Proportion of Intergenic Reads among High Quality Reads
SMAMBRTHQ: High Quality Ambiguous Alignment Rate: Proportion of Ambiguous Reads among High Quality Reads
SME1SNSE: End 1 Sense: End 1 Mapped Reads that intersected with a sense (+) strand feature
SME2SNSE: End 2 Sense: End 2 Mapped Reads that intersected with a sense (+) strand feature
SME1ANTI: End 1 Antisense: End 1 Mapped Reads that intersected with a anti-sense (-) strand feature
SME2ANTI: End 2 Antisense: End 2 Mapped Reads that intersected with a anti-sense (-) strand feature
SME1PCTS: End 1 Sense Rate: Proportion of End 1 Sense reads among End 1 Sense and End 1 Antisense reads
SME2PCTS: End 2 Sense Rate: Proportion of End 2 Sense reads among End 2 Sense and End 2 Antisense reads
SMGNSDTC: Genes Detected: Number of genes with at least 5 (default) High Quality Exonic Reads (--detection-threshold option)
SMRRNARD: rRNA Reads: Mapped Reads that at least partially intersected an annotated rRNA gene
SMRRNART: rRNA Rate: Proportion of rRNA Reads among Mapped Reads
SMMFLGTH: Average Fragment Length: Mean insert size
SMSFLGTH: Fragment Length Std: Standard deviation of insert size
SMMDFLGTH: Fragment Length Median: Median insert size
SMSMFLGTH: Fragment Length MAD_Std: Standard deviation of insert size, computed using median absolute deviation
SMFGCMN: Fragment GC Content Mean: Mean of the fragment-wise GC content distribution
SMFGCSD: Fragment GC Content Std: Standard deviation of the fragment-wise GC content distribution
SMFGCSK: Fragment GC Content Skewness: Skewness of the fragment-wise GC content distribution
SMFGCKT: Fragment GC Content Kurtosis: Kurtosis of the fragment-wise GC content distribution
SM3PBMN: Mean 3' bias: Average 3' bias in read coverage
SM3PBSD: 3' bias Std: Standard deviation of 3' bias in read coverage
SM3PBMD: Median 3' bias: Median 3' bias in read coverage
SM3PB25P: 3' Bias, 25th Percentile: 25th percentile of 3' bias in read coverage
SM3PB75P: 3' Bias, 75th Percentile: 75th percentile of 3' bias in read coverage
SM3PBSDM: 3' bias MAD_Std: Standard deviation of 3' bias in read coverage, computed using median absolute deviation
SM3PBGN: Genes used in 3' bias: Number of genes used for 3' bias calculation. Only genes that are at least 600bp long (--gene-length option) and have at least 5 (--detection-threshold option) High Quality Reads mapping fully and exclusively to the gene are used
SMMDMNCV: Median of Avg Transcript Coverage: Median mean coverage, computed excluding the first and last 500bp of genes, using High Quality Reads mapping fully and exclusively to the gene
SMMDCVSD: Median of Transcript Coverage Std: Median coverage standard deviation, computed excluding the first and last 500bp of genes, using High Quality Reads mapping fully and exclusively to the gene
SMMDCVCV: Median of Transcript Coverage CV: Median coverage coefficient of variation, computed excluding the first and last 500bp of genes, using High Quality Reads mapping fully and exclusively to the gene
SMEXCVMD: Median Exon CV: Median coefficient of variation of exon coverage, computed excluding the first and last 500bp of genes, using High Quality Reads mapping fully and exclusively to the gene
SMEXCVMAD: Exon CV MAD: Standard deviation of the coefficient of variation of exon coverage, computed using median absolute deviation
SMUVCRD: Univec Reads: Reads mapping to UniVec
SMUVCRT: Univec Rate: Proportion of reads mapping to UniVec
SMSHRTRD: Reads too short: Reads that were too short and not mapped
SMSHRTRT: Rate too short: Proportion of reads that were too short
SMSMRDHQ: High Quality smallRNA Reads: Reads that mapped without mismatches to small RNA genes
SMSMRTHQ: High Quality smallRNA Rate: Proportion of reads mapped to small RNA genes without mismatches
SMPRERDHQ: High Quality precursorRNA Reads: Reads that mapped without mismatches to small RNA precursor genes
SMPRERTHQ: High Quality precursorRNA Rate: Proportion of reads that mapped to small RNA precursor genes without mismatches
SMSMGNDT: smallRNA Detected: Number of small RNAs that were detected (>=1 UMIs)
SMPREGNDT: Precursor Genes Detected: Number of small RNA precursors that were detected (>=1 UMIs)
SMRDLNMN: Read Length Mean: Mean read length after clipping adapter and UMI
SMRDLNMD: Read Length Median: Median read length after clipping adapter and UMI
SMRDLNSD: Read Length SD: Read length standard deviation after clipping adapter and UMI
